answer: Shards are assigned from the horizon graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The comet assignment is published and vertex records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 2589 identities would post 3958 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
